name: GRACE GGM02C geoid
description: Geoid undulation relative to the WGS84 ellipsoid, synthesised from the GGM02C spherical-harmonic gravity model. Positive values are where the geoid stands above the ellipsoid (stronger local gravity / excess mass).

source.originator: Center for Space Research, University of Texas at Austin
source.inspiration: https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/3655/ - NASA/Goddard SVS, GRACE Gravity Model
source.credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio; GRACE (NASA/DLR)

grid.order: row-major: latitude outer (north to south), longitude inner (west to east)
